info.title: Awaaz API
info.description: Adult Dhaka pilot backend. Membership grants no location access. Optional geographic routing has unknown safety coverage. SOS delivery is not connected.

post.description: Search imported public OSM names. No GPS, query history or verified entrance is supplied.
Ephemeral geographic route planning. No trip history, traffic ETA, safety score or contact sharing is created.

get.description: Availability of reviewed evidence for the configured real graph. Experimental reported-route comparison may consume this snapshot; safety assessment remains unknown.
Private nearby edges from a registered immutable graph. Human selection is required; proximity does not verify an incident.

post.description: Explicitly associate a live approved report with an actual edge within 35 metres. Publishes fixed-vocabulary coarse evidence, never a safety score.

get.description: Administrator-provisioned moderators only. Private pending submissions; oldest first. No reporter identity is returned.

post.description: Audited idempotent approve/reject decision. Approval stays private pending real graph association; it does not publish an event or safety score.

get.description: Private outgoing block decisions only. Membership and old invitations are not restored by unblocking.

put.description: Version-conditional block/unblock. A stale decision conflicts; it never overrides a newer choice. A successful block disconnects shared circles and revokes conflicting invitations atomically.
